name: Iyogin Holdings, Inc.
summary: Iyogin Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking products and services in Japan. It operates in two segments, Banking and Leasing. The company offers deposit, lending, securities investment, foreign exchange, banking outsourcing, credit guarantee, credit card, and investment fund management services. It also engages in the leasing of office equipment, industrial machinery, machine tools, medical equipment, and others; automotive maintenance lease; and installment payment sales contracts and loans.
